top_examples.hook: The daycare put my dog in an adoption parade before pickup. A volunteer called him abandoned while strangers lined up to take him home.
top_examples.premise: A pet daycare puts a paying client's dog in an adoption parade and tells the crowd he was abandoned while the owner is coming to collect him.
top_examples.title: The Adopt Me Sash at Pickup

top_examples.hook: At my sister's engagement dinner, Mom introduced our foster brother as the caterer. He had cooked every dish, but the place card she hid under his apron said "son."
top_examples.premise: At an engagement dinner, a mother tells the wealthy future in-laws that her foster son is the caterer, even though he was invited as the bride's brother and cooked the meal as a gift.
top_examples.title: Mom Called My Brother the Caterer

top_examples.hook: My groom announced our wedding gifts had funded his startup. I learned about the company when he asked our guests to invest after the first dance.
top_examples.premise: A groom redirects the couple's cash wedding registry into his secret startup and asks reception guests to invest after the first dance.
top_examples.title: The Startup Pitch After Our First Dance

top_examples.hook: Dad grounded me by taking my wheelchair battery. I'm twenty-six, and he said I couldn't leave until I apologized.
top_examples.premise: A father confiscates his adult son's power-wheelchair battery to punish him for refusing to attend a dinner party.
top_examples.title: Dad Kept the Battery in His Cabinet

top_examples.hook: Mom accused me of choosing Dad when I pulled my childhood album out of her bonfire. The pages with my baby pictures were already gone.
top_examples.premise: A divorced mother burns her adult daughter's childhood photo album and accuses her of choosing her father when she tries to rescue it.
top_examples.title: Mom Put My Childhood in the Bonfire
